Thermal scope shoppers: we put together a first look at Falcon Optic's thermal lineup and its Medusa M1V2.0-650L. Manufacturer-listed specs include a 640x512 sensor, 50mm F1.0 lens, 1000-yard laser rangefinder, built-in ballistic calculator, Wi-Fi app and IP67 rating, plus a 5-year warranty. Falcon's Black Friday sale runs through Nov. 30 (EST). We have not tested it yet, and a hands-on review is coming soon. Are you running thermal on your hunting rifle?
